purpose: Illustrated Ink replay segmentation and prompt controls for a reconciliation-bond deadline at Cairn Port.

visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through visual anchors for ordinary isolation-berth work, quiet preparation, independent port and insurer notices, counter-surety, the final clock, and four material outcomes.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use separate visual_scene_id anchors for gallery orientation, the tea routine, auditor and neighbor introduction, each preparation branch, the paired notices, the folded clock state, the final decision, and every ending family. The two simultaneous notices and the opening red tug lock each receive a focused replay beat.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Each base image prompt restates visible geometry, materials, light, bodies, tools, and staging in plain language for a general image model. Character references are assembled only for named characters listed as visible in that frame. Continuity notes remain tooling constraints.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Style: bleak industrial science-fiction noir illustrated in crisp ink line and restrained gouache, slate blue metal, dirty white glass, amber instrument light and sparse emergency red, tactile working surfaces, readable silhouettes, humane facial detail, quiet workplace absurdity under material pressure, cinematic interactive-fiction key frame.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble each generation prompt from global_style_cue, the complete scene base_image_prompt, visual_character_refs only for visible named characters, and triggered state_image_modifiers plus global_branch_image_modifiers. Every generation begins from the camera-specific scene_set view or a fresh render of that view; generated art supplies mood and materials while the scene_set supplies layout.

scene_set_guidance.scope_reason: The fixture returns to one narrow gallery from several angles and depends on window, booth, tool hatch, insurer console, and tug-lock sightlines. The embedded draft map supplies stable zones, cameras, routes, occluders, staging slots, and state anchors for B-level planning.
scene_set_guidance.future_scene_set_need: For website-quality multi-angle art, build a plan-view or simple 3D blockout from the embedded scene_set before image generation.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide view down Cairn Port Isolation Berth I-6, a narrow rectangular pressurized service gallery. A thick pressure window fills the outboard wall and reveals a recessed spacecraft bay holding Common Margin, a compact battered courier with an asymmetrical wedge hull, worn blue-gray ceramic panels, three folded radiator petals, an amber multi-lens sensor crown above the bow, and pale maintenance lamps. The inboard wall contains a small glass audit booth and a waist-high insurer console. A sealed red-framed tug-control window closes the far end, showing an external collar tunnel beyond gallery pressure; a square metal tool hatch closes the near end. Exposed coolant pipes, white floor grids, amber berth lights, and numbered umbilicals make the space feel maintained by workers and owned by schedules. Tamsin Reed, a compact dark-brown-skinned human mechanic with short charcoal curls, an orange quilted pressure vest, navy coveralls, tape-wrapped fingers and magnetic work boots, stands at the warm coolant return with a dented tea tin.

visible_characters.default_stance: docked in the recessed bay beyond the pressure window, maintenance lamps turned toward the gallery
inside the gallery beside the warm coolant return and tea tin

visual_continuity_notes: The gallery is a narrow rectangle: pressure window outboard, audit booth and insurer console inboard, red tug lock at the far end, square neighboring tool hatch at the near end.
Common Margin is the ship body outside the pressure window. The gallery speaker and maintenance lamps express local attention but are not a separate humanoid avatar.
